items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Do you think that you influenced Johnny Richards also? ... Everyone. To me it was one of the greatest things that ever happened in my life.

ctx.x: No, but you see, the American mind is very curious. Is a lot of people that consider an American watching a construction, that is silly, or because they could be entertained for a machine or a noise. They want to know because a year from now you just going through for any new construction and a year from now it going to be a big building, that you would never see the excavation that they made in order to make the foundation, so this is - ahhh - Everybody had in his mind architectural ideas.
Well, Stan Kenton was the first one to openly admit that he got the ideas from you. Are you familiar with Johnny Richards?
